blocks.text:
Text rendering is done using Pango.
The `Pango::Layout` object for printing should be created by calling
the PrintContext::create_pango_layout() method.
The `PrintContext` object also provides the page metrics,
via get_width() and get_height().
The number of pages can be set with
PrintOperation::set_n_pages(). To actually render the
 Pango text in `on_draw_page`, get a
`Cairo::Context` with
PrintContext::get_cairo_context() and show the
`Pango::LayoutLine`s that appear within the requested
page number.
blocks.zh: 文本渲染是使用Pango完成的。Pango::Layout对象应通过调用PrintContext::create_pango_layout()方法来创建。PrintContext对象还通过get_width()和get_height()方法提供了页面范围。页数可以通过调用PrintOperation::set_n_pages()进行设置。要在on_draw_page中渲染文本，请使用PrintContext::get_cairo_context()获取Cairo::Context并显示在请求的页码中出现的Pango::LayoutLine。
